bestBets.overview: Even Class 1 to kick off proceedings at Wyong. I was impressed by the last-start win of SAVOONGA, smart ride overall and her last 200m was eye-catching. Up to 1600m now from an inside draw points towards back-to-back wins. MY COUNTRY BOY comes here off a last-start win also, slightly sticky map from gate 8 but will be running on late. ORANGE TSUNAMI maps well here, the third of the last-start winners and with that victory now, he can go on with things. SMICHOV is next best but does need to find 1-2L to be competitive here.

raceTips.comment: My Country Boy has been racing consistently and looks suited by the likely race shape, with enough tactical speed to settle handy and get every chance late. Northern Eagle has been competitive in similar company and should be able to settle just behind the leaders before getting his chance in the straight. Savoonga was drawing clear through the line when she knocked off her maiden last time out which not only suggests she will appreciate the rise in distance, but that she can measure up in this better company.

bestBets.overview: Keen to bet into this race. The Annabel and Rob Archibald team look to have a lovely progressive type in BORDERFALL. He has caught the eye in back-to-back trials with the latest the pick in fast time when dictating from on speed. He maps ideally on debut and is the horse to beat. LADY CAPITALIST is the danger, drawn wide but will roll forward no doubt. She showed good tactical speed in her latest trial and will get first crack at angling to the superior lanes in the straight. OLE LIZZY has had the two trials leading in, this is key for Team Hawkes runners. She's been solid in both and gets Morgan on board, the knock is the sticky draw. LOBBYIST looks to have a new lease on life under the new trainer Amanda Turner, big market watch.

raceTips.comment: The Archibald trained Borderfall is well placed resuming over the 1200m and if able to reproduce the rating from his only career start last preparation he will be hard to beat. Lady Capitalist has trialled well leading in and with the superior early speed in the race will find the front and dictate the tempo to suit. Expecting competitive first up performances from Usain Boss & Lobbyist over the suitable 1200m with in form jockeys on board both gallopers

bestBets.overview: Lacklustre 1350m Maiden Plate overall. The clear standout is the Brad Widdup-trained ANTHROPOID, smart fresh run in a very strong form race. He was off the bit a long way out but kept finding. Off that, the rise in trip and option to be ridden with cover suit. Both GOLDEN GODDESS and CRISPY LEAVES look over the odds. CRISPY LEAVES has been smart in two very sneaky good trials while GOLDEN GODDESS was smart on debut in a very strong maiden race. Both get lovely setups from the draw and look solid place bets. CAPE DOUGLAS landed in a lovely spot last time out at Hawkesbury before finding the line well, sticky draw but goes in the mix.

raceTips.comment: Anthropoid has continued to race in good heart and brings the right combination of speed and toughness, making him hard to leave out of the finish. Golden Goddess has plenty of ability and should settle comfortably, giving herself every opportunity to finish strongly when the pressure goes on. Bobby has been competitive and can be dangerous if he gets the right run throughout, with enough class to figure prominently late. What A Gent next.

bestBets.overview: As tough as you'll find a race. CHARLEROI has been well backed in early markets but is also dual accepted. The firm deck is the worry but a move back to the home track and a drop back in class read well. LADY PANKHURST will need some luck early to overcome the gate. She's looked sharp in two recent trials and can surprise for an in-form John Sargent stable. STAKEHOLDER peaks here third up, sticky gate but this should see the gelding ridden positively early. BOLD DESIGNS did enough last time out at this track when in a bunched finish. Smart use of the claim and goes in the mix.

raceTips.comment: Bold Design has shown enough this preparation to suggest another competitive performance is coming, with his ability to race on speed a valuable asset. Stakeholder has been consistent in similar company and looks capable of holding a prominent position before being asked for an effort in the straight. Charleroi has the ability to improve sharply when things fall into place and should not be underestimated if he gets a clean passage, with his strength through the latter stages an important factor. Lady Pankhurst next.

bestBets.overview: Smart race this, the Mona Lisa Prelude over the 1200m. An above-average tempo expected up front, keen to side with the Joe Pride-trained JUST GLAMOUROUS, she has residual fitness off a smart last-start effort. She looked sharp in a recent tick-over trial and is very much suited here over 1200m. MRS MAREE is the danger, 1200m fresh is a slight query but she did truck up in a recent 792m trial. Race in two. DIDDLE DUMPLING goes in the mix, her best runs are often fresh, a touch of rain would only increase her chances. COUPLES RETREAT has the race fitness edge and is in form, the knock is gate 10.

raceTips.comment: Raskol won well over 1100m last start at Canterbury and would have taken further improvement off that performance, maps to enjoy a soft run stalking the speed and saved for one sprint at them late. Expecting strong first up performances from Mrs Maree & Just Glamourous over the suitable 1200m with in form jockeys on board both gallopers.

bestBets.overview: The feature of the day is the Wyong Cup Prelude over the 2000m. The John O'Shea x Lloyd combination looks hardest to beat with HOVLAND. He maps ideally from gate 4, coming off a strong last-start win at Eagle Farm. Anywhere near that figure suggests he's hard to beat. MO CHROI looks very well placed here, smart fresh win but has been found wanting in his last two efforts. Back in class here and should get a soft lead. ANYTHINK GOES has been well backed in early markets. Dry or wet doesn't matter, 2000m is perfect and gets Collett in the saddle. CAPTAIN FENKEL has been a drifter early, dual accepted as well. If here, no doubt in the mix off some solid form.

raceTips.comment: Hovland comes out. Anythink Goes has plenty of speed and can put himself into the race early, with his ability to sustain a long run making him a genuine threat. Visualise has been finding the line solidly and can benefit from settling off the pace before being produced at the right time. Captain Fenkel has enough ability to be competitive and should be kept safe if the tempo increases throughout the middle stages, with an in-form jockey aboard another positive. Mo Chroi next.

bestBets.overview: Good race to round out the meeting. At the price I'll lean the way of the fresh REMEMBER JACK, he has been trialling up impressively before being scratched at the gates. If FLEET FLYER runs up to anywhere near the figure she produced fresh she'll win this, gate 15 doesn't make it any easier though. BRING ME CHOCOLATE has the most upside to come, impressive fresh win and maps ideally here second up. If here, BARJNORD goes in the mix.

raceTips.comment: Key scratchings open the race up. Smiling Prophet has a useful turn of foot and can become dangerous if allowed to travel comfortably before being asked for an effort. Bring Me Chocolate has been competitive without everything going his way and can improve with a more economical run in transit, with his ability to sustain a strong finish making him a genuine chance if the race is run to suit. Remember Jack and Celestial Deal now come into calculations.
